description: The grid cases of the layout model. Each case builds a grid from state, the slicing tree {root} of packages/soksak/docs/layout.md#the-model, and options and runs its steps in order: get and set read and write a property, any other call is the method of that name with args. A step with returns gives that value, numbers within a relative 1e-9; a step with throws fails with that message; a step with neither gives no value. A case with throws fails at the construction.

cases.name: a grid without a state is one card filling the plane
the options set the gap, the minimum, the grab size, the snap and the plane
options that are not numbers in range keep the defaults
the setters refuse a value out of range and keep the one set
the reads of a plane of three cards
a drop lands on the centre or the nearest side of the card under it
the card setters change one card and refuse an unknown one
splits cut a card into two and the new card takes the far half
a split toward a side puts the new card on that side
a split refuses halves below the minimum
a split of a card with a px size divides the size
a close scales the other kids of its cut by one factor
a close lets a row of neighbours fill the space
a close of the middle card gives both neighbours a share in proportion
a dragged boundary moves its line within the range and snaps onto a neighbour
a boundary beside a px size changes the size
two px sizes on one boundary trade their sizes
an insert places a plane-spanning card at a boundary
an insert at a boundary of an even row takes the span from every kid in proportion
a move takes a card to a side of another and keeps its id and payload
a box frames its inner node one corridor inside its left, right and bottom sides and stands one corridor from its neighbour, and its head is drawn inside the top of the card below it
the frames of boxes on the two sides of a line are costs of the cut, and the kids share the rest by their fractions
a box in one kid of a column frames only its own card, and the other kid is drawn to the line
a px size is the drawn size of a card inside the frame of its box
arrange even puts the cards in reading order into an equal grid and removes every merge and size
arrange even adds one empty card when the grid closest to square has one cell more than the cards
arrange even gives every cell the same drawn size with the border insets in the line spacing
arrange even changes nothing and is false when no equal grid keeps every cell at minSize, and refuses another mode
newLine cuts at a new line at the centre where a line that the card spans across lies inside it
without newLine a split takes the line inside the card
even gives every child of every cut an equal share
even gives two rows of the same count the same lines
even counts the head of a box, so the member below the head and its sibling are drawn at one height below it
four inserts toward right from the last card give five cards of one drawn width (P2)
inserts toward right from one card put each new card beside it at 1/(n+1) of the row (P2)
a withdraw from a row of four gives its space to the three others in proportion (P1)
a withdraw keeps the proportions of the cards that take the space (P1)
an insert across a row wraps the target in a new cut at half of its rectangle and makes no box (P3)
an insert beside neighbouring children wraps them as one target

steps.throws: cards a, c are not neighbours of one cut

cases.name: an insert along a column of a box with a head gives the three members one height below the head (P2)
a move is a withdraw and an insert

steps.throws: card a is a member of the layout

cases.name: a withdrawn box lands with its members in their proportions
the cut operations refuse an unknown side, a card that is no member, the last card and a fixed card

steps.throws: unknown side up; use left, right, top or bottom
card zz is not a member of the layout
card s is a member of the layout
card zz is not a member of the layout
card a is the last card of the layout
card s is fixed and does not leave

cases.name: a drop on the right zone of the first card of an even row of three adds a card along the row, which gives four quarters
a drop on the line between the first and the second card of an even row of three gives four quarters
a drop on the top edge of the plane wraps the row in a column of two halves, and the row keeps its proportions
a move of the third card of an even row of eight below the last card leaves seven cards of one width in the row
an add along a cut that is not even takes half of the target and keeps every other size
an add at the end of a cut that is not even takes half of the child at that end
an add that would draw a card below its minimum is refused, names the card, its size and its minimum, and changes nothing

steps.throws: card b would be 53x600, below its minimum 96x96

cases.name: an add that would draw a box below the minimum of its members and its head names the box

steps.throws: card g would be 140x148, below its minimum 96x260

cases.name: a state of the earlier form with lines and cells is refused
cases.throws: soksak: the state holds xs, ys and cards, which is the earlier form; the state is {root}

cases.name: a state that records a payer is refused
cases.throws: soksak: the state holds paidBy, which the layout does not record; the state is {root}

cases.name: a node that is no card, box or cut is refused
cases.throws: soksak: the node {"id":"a"} is not a card, a box or a cut

cases.name: a cut with one kid is refused
cases.throws: soksak: the cut root is not canonical: it has fewer than two kids

cases.name: a kid cut along the axis of its cut is refused
cases.throws: soksak: the cut root.1 is not canonical: it is a cut along the axis of its cut

cases.name: shares that do not sum to 1 are refused
cases.throws: soksak: the cut root is not canonical: its shares sum to 0.9

cases.name: a share that is not positive is refused
cases.throws: soksak: the cut root is not canonical: the share of kid 1 is 0

cases.name: two nodes with one id are refused
